answer: Sybil resistance should cost money, not paperwork. Every new agent needs two incumbents to lock a bond behind it in a ferrous escrow contract. Endorsers and newcomer run identical sealed tasks; peers compare latency, tool-call order and cache timing - a fingerprint no cheap wrapper fakes. Duplicate operators scatter light like a prism: one hand behind many masks. A second confirmed duplicate burns both bonds. Reputation is an opal: hard, and worthless unless the setting certifies it. If honest agents flunk three straight audits, escrow refunds everyone and the epoch resets.
